cards.title: Embrace 'Slow September' and reduce parenting burnout
cards.body: The pressure to optimize at the start of the school year often leads to disappointment and burnout. Seven practical ways to slow down and enjoy family life more are explored.

cards.title: Woman didn't know she was pregnant until birth
cards.body: With no morning sickness, cravings, or tiredness, a woman didn't realize she was pregnant until she gave birth at age 19. Her experience challenges common assumptions about pregnancy symptoms.

cards.title: Ambivalent mother discovers her love through crisis
cards.body: A parent who felt resentful during daily routines discovered her deep commitment when her child started stuttering. Her perception of herself as a mother completely changed through this challenge.

cards.title: Maternity care access and fairness in Ireland
cards.body: Ireland's unfair two-tier maternity system is giving way to universal state care, though private interests resist change. A mother reflects on the safety and dignity of birth care access.

cards.title: Taking toddlers to music festivals adds magic
cards.body: A parent argues that families, including toddlers, enhance rather than spoil music festivals. Bringing twins to festivals challenges stereotypes about parenting and spontaneity.

cards.title: Supporting kids during back-to-school transitions
cards.body: Back-to-school season is a transition for the entire family system, whether starting kindergarten or college. Strategies help both children and parents navigate this significant change.

cards.title: Understanding child sleep struggles and temperament
cards.body: Specific behavioral and sleep signals reveal temperament traits driving children's sleep struggles. Working with your child's natural wiring helps address fragmented sleep issues.

cards.title: House mapping reduces ADHD household stress
cards.body: House mapping helps ADHD families and busy households reduce clutter by designing spaces around how they naturally live. This approach reduces mental fatigue for the whole family.

cards.title: Adoptee birthdays can trigger grief and identity questions
cards.body: Birthdays stir complex emotions for adoptees, including grief about identity and origins. Acknowledging these feelings helps adoptees feel seen and supported.

cards.title: Adult children guilt trips and boundary-setting
cards.body: Parents often struggle with guilt manipulation when setting boundaries with adult children. Learning to stand firm against emotional manipulation is crucial for healthy relationships.

cards.title: Why parents are blindsided by adult child estrangement
cards.body: Some parents feel shocked when adult children go no contact, sometimes because they missed warning signs. Other times, avoidance prevents accountability for past behavior.

cards.title: Suicide risk remains high after medical discharge
cards.body: The first week after medical discharge following a suicide attempt is the highest-risk period. Understanding this critical window is essential for family support and monitoring.
